purpose: Independent source audit; no human difficulty inference and no synthetic win rates.

soccer.mode: 11v11 full pitch, v241 recovery, v23 control, league

evidence.detail: applySoccerFull overrides JSON match duration and pitch.
Default long-league calendar; game stages are reused circuit/tier IDs.
League stages run as engine4..33 after the original three.
Entry stages wrap street play with v24 interior flow; street-only trials are incomplete.
Actual browser defaults; canvas-free session skips the chase and must not represent shipped play.
Shared alien, naval and fire settlement.

soccerStars.rule: Win clean sheet=3, otherwise winning margin>=2=2, otherwise win=1; loss=0 at settlement.

evidence.detail: Optional achievement is transient; loss can still teach an action.
Performance determines stage stars; certificate generated separately.
Generated wave fallback has no terminal stage.
Complete wave increments nextWave and opens shop; no stars.

alpineLeague.rule: Place goal required to pass; stars count passed place, time, and clean/gate goals. Base stages use rank stars.

evidence.detail: starsFor returns zero without the place goal.

nativeSemantics.falls: Only report a native crash/fall counter where supplied. HP loss, missed shots, deaths, contacts and abandonment are not interchangeable with falls.

evidence.detail: Completed result must equal two halfSeconds.
Live game clock decreases by dt, not accelerated time.

limitations: Static parameter changes can offset each other; this list is a review queue, not a claim of an observed difficulty spike.
All fresh-equipment trials test stage requirements at fixed equipment; later-stage failures can reflect intended purchase/training progression.
Native-completion rates must be separated from patience deadlines so a long mandatory match does not become a fabricated logic loss.
An endless campaign cannot be exhaustively simulated; the finite wave horizon must be stated prominently.
